form.notes: Form revision 2, reviewed by the user-delegated root agent. All five actual Blender renders inspected. Targeted simplification preserves clear door openings, staircase silhouette, broad parquet, learning furniture and the unchanged guide. Faceted foliage suits the stylised material palette. Independent reopened-source audit confirms 22 assets, 21486 unique triangles, clear doors, 16 measured treads, 1.396 m rail clearance and 11 guide groups. This approves revised model form and export, not final browser runtime or the projected dense-campus triangle count. Export verification: the same reviewed source produced all 22 FBX files; the asset audit hash was refreshed only to record those exports. A subsequent structured FBX export removed only native source-path metadata; fbx-metadata-audit.json proves identical parsed geometry, transforms, materials and connections.

runtime.notes: Approved actual assembled models, physical door/stair/support/rebuild behavior, real browser UI and two camera modes, scoped measured performance and functioning WebAudio context/mixer controls. Review uses actual browser observations, not the shell preview. Public URL verification follows deployment.

delegatedReview.scope: Further design, model and runtime checks delegated to Codex by the user instruction to approve the plans and build the whole thing, following the offered delegation. No additional costs. Record actual evidence before approving each subsequent milestone.
